Find sources: "Gwangsan Kim clan" – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR ( January 2021 ) ( Learn how and when to remove this message ) Gwangsan Kim clan Country North and South Korea Current region Gwangju Founder Kim Hŭng-gwang Website kwangsankim .co .kr The Gwangsan Kim clan ( Korean : 광산 김씨 ; Hanja : 光山 金氏 ) is a Korean clan with its bon-gwan located in Gwangsan, present-day Gwangju . [ 1 ] The members of the Gwangsan Kim clan are the descendants of Kim Hŭng-gwang ( Korean : 김흥광 ; Hanja : 金興光 ), the third son of King Sinmu of Silla , the 45th monarch of the Silla .
